title: Fix TypeSpec LRO operations: remove @extension, use @useFinalStateVia

artifactEvidence.autorest: base/head OpenAPI both retain x-ms-long-running-operation and final-state-via location
artifactEvidence.tcgc: the head uses TypeSpec LRO metadata understood by TCGC instead of an OpenAPI-only extension

items.intent: Make six ARM action operations visible as LROs to both OpenAPI and SDK generators by replacing OpenAPI-only extensions with TypeSpec LRO metadata.
transformationChain: Retain 202, Location, Retry-After, polling, and final-result wire behavior.

restRepresentation.summary: The six POST operations remain 202 ARM LROs using Location and Retry-After with final-state-via location; the change fixes SDK LRO recognition without changing their REST signatures.

operations.serviceBehavior: Starts a scenario run and returns before execution completes.

lro.polling: Wait Retry-After, then poll the Location URL until the scenario run reaches a terminal state.

responsePayloads: 202: no body; Location and Retry-After headers

operations.serviceBehavior: Starts asynchronous validation of a scenario configuration.

lro.polling: Poll Location after Retry-After until terminal completion.
lro.finalResult: Validation result from the Location endpoint.

responsePayloads: 202: no body; Location and Retry-After headers

findings.title: Generated SDK methods change from synchronous to long-running
findings.summary: The wire contract is unchanged, but SDKs now expose poller/LRO return types and asynchronous completion semantics.
evidence: @useFinalStateVia is visible to both AutoRest and TCGC while @extension was OpenAPI-only.

documents.title: Azure.Core decorators
documents.guidanceExcerpt: Overrides the final state value for an operation. The supported values include `location`.
documents.applicableGuidance: Use @useFinalStateVia("location") to select the Location-based LRO final-state strategy.

documents.title: ARM long-running operations
documents.guidanceExcerpt: The `ArmResourceActionAsync` template uses `ArmLroLocationHeader` by default. The `FinalResult` should match the response type of the action.
documents.applicableGuidance: Location-polled ARM actions use matching Location headers, Retry-After, and logical final-result types.
documents.evidence: The helpers use ArmLroLocationHeader<FinalResult = ...>, RetryAfterHeader, and concrete action result types.

documents.title: Azure Core no-openapi rule
documents.guidanceExcerpt: Azure specs should not be using decorators from @typespec/openapi or @azure-tools/typespec-autorest because other emitters will not be able to understand them.
documents.applicableGuidance: Represent behavior with emitter-independent TypeSpec and Azure constructs instead of raw OpenAPI extensions.
documents.evidence: The PR removes raw x-ms-long-running-operation extensions and replaces them with Azure.Core LRO metadata.
